sources.title: Sexual dimorphism in the complete connectome of the Drosophila male central nervous system — final Cell article
sources.notes: Final September 3, 2026 Cell paper. Supplied drosophila-2026.pdf inspected via tmp/pdfs/drosophila-2026.txt. 166700 neurons,11710 types,124.2M retained synaptic links,25.6M edges,40.1% both-ended completion. CC BY 4.0. Authoritative over earlier abstract counts.

sources.title: MaleCNS preprint version 2
sources.notes: Supplied link. October 30,2025 preprint superseded by final Cell version; browser fetch403 is not evidence of paywall.

sources.title: A connectomics milestone: Mapping the complete male fruit fly brain
sources.notes: September3,2026 announcement links both female and male resources. Headline rounded numbers are not exact graph statistics.

sources.title: Male CNS Connectome — Janelia project
sources.notes: Official entrypoint; v1.0 release June8,2026 and final publication September3. Some summary dimorphism counts still correspond to earlier release.

sources.title: MaleCNS download documentation
sources.notes: Official public bulk files; neuPrint account/token for API. CC BY4.0. Segment graph includes fragments and must be filtered.

sources.title: MaleCNS release notes
sources.notes: v1.0 June8,2026. Notes call v0.9 October5,2025 while project news call October3; preserve discrepancy if precise original release timing matters.

sources.title: Google publication abstract for MaleCNS
sources.notes: 166691 neurons/11691 types and older dimorphism numbers differ from final supplied Cell PDF; not used for current exact counts.

sources.title: Neuronal wiring diagram of an adult brain
sources.notes: 2024 FlyWire female brain;139255 neurons and54.5M retained chemical synaptic links. Brain not VNC. User provided drosophila-2024.pdf.

sources.title: Whole-brain annotation and multi-connectome cell typing of Drosophila
sources.notes: 2024 annotation companion paper; distinguishes individual variation, technical noise and cell-type conservation.

sources.title: Distributed control circuits across a brain-and-cord connectome — final Nature BANC paper
sources.notes: PublishedJune8,2026; v888 materializationApril17,2026.155916 proofread/roughly proofread neurons;18% both-ended synapse attachment. Female lamina/ocellar omissions and antennal damage. BANC claim that MaleCNS also lacks lamina conflicts with final MaleCNS Methods, so do not generalize it.

sources.title: BANC final publication PubMed record
sources.notes: PMCID PMC13518251; DOI10.1038/s41586-026-10735-w; final journal citation Nature656:957-970,August2026, epubJune8.

sources.title: BANC v888 final Dataverse deposit
sources.notes: Final static deposit linked by authors. Dataverse API and page blocked; GCS mirror accessible. Do not infer subscription requirement.

sources.title: BANC project analysis repository
sources.notes: CC BY4.0 code and data declared; included code archives may differ. README~188000 neurons/199M predicted synapses is not paper155916 proofread/roughly-proofread inventory.

sources.title: BANC data location index
sources.notes: Lists bulk files; v2 detection-size threshold>=5, v3>=10. These are not neuron-pair synapse count thresholds. NT filename without_v2 is404; corrected by public object inventory.

sources.title: BANC post-proofreading pipeline
sources.notes: Data preprocessing, matching and typing; GCS mirror evolves, Dataverse provides frozen paper snapshot.

sources.title: Comparative connectomics of Drosophila descending and ascending neurons
sources.notes: 2025 integrated FAFB/FANC/MANC neck-connective atlas; cross-specimen correspondence is inferred, not continuous physical reconstruction.

sources.title: FANC automated reconstruction and client
sources.notes: Female VNC resource, sparse/targeted reconstruction. Repository code GPL3.0; data license must be checked separately.

sources.title: MANC official project
sources.notes: Male VNC, not whole brain;~23000 neurons. DatasetCC BY. Public GCS bulk data and neuPrint.

sources.title: A Connectome of the Male Drosophila Ventral Nerve Cord
sources.notes: eLife2024 reviewed-preprint cited by official project; browser fulltext blocked. Prefer project+companion literature for inspected details.

sources.title: A Drosophila computational brain model reveals sensorimotor processing
sources.notes: Shiu2024 Brian2 LIF model. Feeding/grooming validations; missing internal state,gap junctions,non-spiking cells,long-range peptides;0Hz baseline.91% tested predictions,84% excluding optogenetic set dominated by negatives.

sources.title: Drosophila_brain_model code
sources.notes: User-supplied LIF brain model source. Root agent handles detailed code/license reproducibility audit.

sources.title: FlyWire neuron annotations
sources.notes: v783 segmentation; annotation2.1.0 matches2024 papers;3.1.0 updates for peer-reviewed maleCNS. Authors warn Codex annotations mix sources. Pin tag+commit.

sources.title: FlyWire v783 connectivity dataset
sources.notes: ZenodoAPI licensecc-by-4.0. Proofread IDs~1.1MB;proofread_connections~852MB;all synapses~9.5GB. Per-neuropil rows may require aggregation. Orphan endpoints present in all-synapse table.

sources.title: Codex FlyWire FAQ and release list
sources.notes: Public dataset selector listed FAFB783,BANC888,MANC1.2.1,MAOL1.1,MCNS0.9. MCNS here lagged official1.0; BANC release dateMay20 differs from CAVE materializationApril17.
